facts.text: I need cold outbound emails for my sales outreach.
I want an outbound email outreach with 6 sequences.
I want to target Founder, Co-founder, C level, and executive titles.
I want to avoid using the word "Demo" in the emails.
I want the subject lines to be short with 3 to 4 words only.
I want the emails to clearly articulate the problem Comparative can solve and the value it can deliver.
I want the emails to differentiate Comparative from other analytics and business intelligence tools.
I want to include a one-pager link in one of the email sequences: https://hubs.ly/Q01f8VXL0.
I want to include an explainer video link in one of the email sequences: https://tinyurl.com/yu9uwe2z.
I want the emails written from the perspective of the co-founder of the company.
I want the emails written in an AIDA email style.
In the last email sequence, I want to inform the reader that this will be the last email outreach.
I want each email to be written in 150 words only.
I want the emails to not be too salesy.
I asked to continue sequence 5 and 6.
I asked to review the information I shared one by one and the rules, then create another version of the cold outbound email sequence.
I asked to start with sequence 1.
I asked to continue sequence 2 to 6.

events.text: Requested continuation of email sequences 5 and 6
Requested review of rules and creation of another version of the cold outbound email sequence
Requested continuation of email sequences 2 to 6
